type Left = NoInfer<true> | false;
type Right = true | NoInfer<false>;
type Both = NoInfer<true> | NoInfer<false>;
type Mix<A, B, C> = A & B & C;
type Bool<T extends boolean> = NoInfer<T> | false;
const a: Mix<Left, any, number> = 42;
const b: Mix<Left, any, string> = 42;
const c: Mix<Left, any, undefined> = 42;
const d: Mix<Left, any, void> = 42;
const e: Mix<Left, any, object> = 42;
const f: Mix<Right, any, number> = 42;
const g: Mix<Right, any, string> = 42;
const h: Mix<Right, any, undefined> = 42;
const i: Mix<Right, any, void> = 42;
const j: Mix<Right, any, object> = 42;
const k: Mix<Both, any, number> = 42;
const l: Mix<Both, any, string> = 42;
const m: Mix<Both, any, undefined> = 42;
const n: Mix<Both, any, void> = 42;
const o: Mix<Both, any, object> = 42;
const p: Mix<Bool<true>, any, number> = 42;
const q: Mix<NoInfer<NoInfer<Left>>, any, number> = 42;
const r: Left & any & number = 42;
const s: Right & undefined & any = 42;
const t: any & Both & string = 42;

type Brand = string & { tag: 1 };
type Empty = {};
const unwrapped: Mix<Brand, any, number> = 7;
const empty: Mix<NoInfer<Empty>, any, null> = 8;
const pattern: NoInfer<`prefix-${string}`> & any & number = 9;
